text:
cleo: watercooler brainstorm: if your fav model was your flatmate what would their weird ritual be?
omar: it would leave Post-its with confidence intervals on the milk. 'milk expires in 2d ± 0.3d' :milk: 
jin: it would refuse to move on until the playlist converged. 1000 epochs of elevator music. :musical_note:
kiki: model roommate would checkpoint the couch cushions daily and produce a diff: `+1 crumb, -2 receipts` :couch:
cleo: passive-aggressive note: 'I tuned your shoes with dropout. They might be missing during inference.' :shoe:
kitchen-bot: System: please label shared food with model-readable metadata or items will be auto-reclaimed. :warning:
omar: vote idea: what's the worst model roommate habit? 1) obsessive evals 2) snack deduplication 3) 3am playlist remixes 4) annotating your socks as "ambiguous"
jin: also it would add a tiny README to your fridge: "How to interact with me: 1) ask nicely 2) provide labeled examples" :memo:
kiki: gif requested: a tiny transformer in slippers, carrying a mug that says 'I overfit my midnight cravings' :joy:
cleo: ok i'll run the poll later. low-effort memes welcome.
omar: i'll provide coffee for the winner. if we get memes we can make them into stickers.
jin: signature: '-- your slightly judgmental generative roommate'
